dedupe_keys.name: physico mechanical characterization of homogeneity and isotropy of prototype earth block material

description: Physico-Mechanical Characterization of Homogeneity and Isotropy of Prototype Earth Block Material is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Fabio Matta, University of South Carolina (sc.edu). Compressed and stabilized earth blocks (CSEBs) are typically manufactured through one-side compaction. The resulting soil matrix-hydrated cement microstructure is heterogeneous, posing the question of whether CSEB materials can be considered homogeneous and isotropic for the purpose of analysis of CSEB structures, similar to rammed earth. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Compressive strength, earth masonry, isotropy, homogeneity, statistical analysis. Published 2023-01-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
